reviews.text: Professional, on time and good Grooming 👍 👌 …
Thank you so much I love this place
always a great job and always friendly.

Very disappointing experience. We picked up our dog just minutes ago, and he wasn’t dried thoroughly or cleaned properly—his backside was dirty, although we dropped him off with his butt clean!

We could hear him barking desperately behind the door, and he came home stressed and shaking! 🚩🚩🚩

The young woman at the front desk was rude, and the customer service was awful. We expected much better care and professionalism. I would not recommend this place to other pet owners.

Booked my 12 year old senior cat an appointment with Pet Wash this week. Great service and enjoyed speaking with Veronica the owner, great inventory of clean pet food product as well which was a plus.

I also want to add that they are extremely mindful of your pets limits. Even though Sylvester came back semi-wet it made me relived to know that it was a choice for his best interest and showed how much attention to emotional detail was given. Thank you!
Within 24 hours of getting my dogs nails trimmed here she developed and infection. I had to take her to the emergency vet where she was prescribed antibiotics. Be aware.
Wonderful location, super cut and wash, friendly people.
All of the above. I am sold on going back. Amazing thank you, you guys same as always
Cat claws cut.
Nice place to wash a dog.
Great service! The staff is very kind and gentle . I highly recommend them!

The experience that I have had with pet wash is above and beyond awesome customer service from beginning to end Giv, respect you get respect They treat my pup as if it’s their own  I love the fact that I can trust each, and everyone that represents pet wash. Prices are good. And they get the job done with finesse my Shih Tzu. Romeo means the world to me for me to trust pet wash. It says volumes about their business. I Would like to give a shout out to pet wash. They really do an excellent job.

Pet Wash is a treasure and just a wonderful place to get your dog groomed. The team there is SO nice all around and the groomers do a great job. When I picked my dog up after a massive cut this afternoon (he had bits of matting all over, too), he was really happy, wagging his tale, not making a mad dash to escape, like when I give him a bath!! I really recommend Pet Wash!

i have two large and rambunctious dogs and came into use their self service dog wash and made it right before 5, their cut off time for using the self service but they didn’t mind! the lady at the register was super nice and accommodating! my dogs are super high energy and dramatic asf when they get baths and just LOVE to make a huge mess while i bathe them (part of the their dramatic temperament) but the lady at the front reassured me that it was no problem after i offered to clean up the wet floor and said they’d take care of it. super nice and great experience after just moving into the neighborhood. definitely going to be my go-to monthly dog wash spot! thanks for helping get my doggos clean!
Great service! Hector did my dogs nails and he’s super chill and friendly!! Love coming here!!
Best pricing, flexible times, all in one service. Deshed, shampoo, blow dry, clean ears, cut nails, squeeze glands. Easily the best shop I’ve ever been to.
It is always a great experience when I come and have my dog pepper washed at this facility. Everybody so nice she doesn’t come out scared she always smells so good for several days!! 🥰
Always a pleasant experience. Good customer service , clean and nicely organized place.

Absolutely amazing service! They did such a wonderful job with my cat’s grooming and bath. You can tell they truly care about the animals. I can’t wait to bring my other fur babies here. Highly recommend!
I highly recommend Pet Wash. I took my Lucy  my there for over 9 years and since Covid was done, I’ve been taking my Luna. They are fast and wonderful.
Hector is great with all of our dogs! They love this place and I feel safe with them there

Thank you for the great grooming experience.
It Was easy to book an appointment
Thank you
I god a wash and dry and my dog looks well brushed too after his bath. They took a lot of unwanted shedding fur off him too!
They are great! My dog legit likes going inside!

I booked the Dog full service grooming, and I honestly couldn’t be happier with the experience. The groomer did an absolutely incredible job—my dog looked cleaner, happier, and better groomed than ever before. Every little detail was handled with so much care and professionalism, and it’s obvious that the staff genuinely love what they do.

I also want to give a special shout-out to the girl at the front desk. She was incredibly friendly, welcoming, and helpful from the moment I walked in. She made the whole process smooth and answered all of my questions with a smile, making me feel like a valued customer. Great customer service like that is hard to find.

This is easily the best grooming salon I’ve visited, and I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone looking for top-quality pet care. Five stars without a doubt—I will definitely be coming back! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I’ve been coming here for over three years. Never had a problem. I’ve never had an issue with my dog chewing her leash during the grooming process. Various groomers have never involved my own leash in the past until today. Going unnoticed my dog chewed her leash, leaving me to purchase a new one. No discount was offered or even a discounted leash from the store. I left with a training leash which they should have been using in the first place.
Clean inside. Accommodating with everything everything needed to wash my fog.  Friendly staff.
Our local dog groomer, easy to book online, always friendly and my dog always enjoys his visits. He walks into their shop eagerly so I know they treat him well.
Not sure why they changed the cashier to someone who slurs at customers she thinks are republican. Businesses shouldnt play politics.

I have to give this place 5 stars.  Unfortunately my cats would not agree to getting groomed, but Pet Wash handled the situation very well.   They kept my cats safe by not moving forward.
Thank you for making the right judgment and keeping my girls safe.  I will absolutely recommend to other pet owners.
Got two washes and cuts for my pups. They came out smelling and looking fresh!
Great service. They know how to deal with my husky :-)
It is always the best experience. They take care of all three of my babies🩷🩷

Great job! They are my go-to place for my dogs
nail trim
Great experience! Pup looks perfect every time, service is spectacular! A gem of a groomer. Definite strong recommendation
Did a great job washing and nail clipping my black lab

Amazing!!! They put on my cats vinyl nails so she doesn't have to wear the cone of shame.
And I picked up some great products while there. So glad I found you guys.

I’ve been bringing Ella, to Hollywood Pet Wash for a long time now, and I brought my previous dogs here for years before that. I can't say enough good things about them. The customer service is absolutely amazing, and the way they treat the dogs is fantastic. They are always on time, which I really appreciate, and incredibly accommodating with their availability whenever I need to get her in. Truly top-notch service every single time. Highly recommend!
I love 💕 how well my pups are treated and how happy they are when I pick them up. They look amazing! …
Nice job
It was our first time there. Before that, I always bathed my dog myself, so as a loving dog parent I was a little worried. But in the end, my Colonel was very happy — and so was I. Excellent service!
Great job grooming our fussy Husky. We typically add a de-shed to our groom. Very responsive on the phone and easy to make an appointment.
They always do a great job!
Excellent service for your pet.
Wonderful place! Appointments are flexible and the customer service is always amazing! Very budget friendly and professional. I highly recommend.

Hollywood Pet Wash is great! It’s convenient, there’s always parking, I love supporting a small neighborhood business & they’re consistently nice people - It may not be the fussy couture boutique hound wash with the associated aesthetics & price point, but I prefer a simple do it yourself place for these purposes.

Robert Steloff Design
reasonable price and friendly staff. store nice and clean.
Always great
Good service and price is around 65 for my Korean Jindo.

I took my dog here for the 1st time. I needed a bath and de-shed asap, and my usual place was booked for weeks. Firstly, they have a $25 deposit for appointment, in case its canceled less than 24hrs before. If not canceled, the $25 goes to your visit. Thats reasonable.
I wasn't sure if I was in the right place arriving, it looked like a pet store inside. Nice if you need to pick something up for your dog. I did not, so I can't speak to prices but the selection seemed good.
They were priced well for my large girl, and a bonus is they let me add on individual grooming items to a bath... I needed a paw pad trim with her bath. Not every place lets you do that! You'd think this would be common but plenty places in my area either want you to do a whole grooming or have packages only you can add.
Her bath was finished in a reasonable amount of time, they did a good job on her de-shed, and a great job on the added paw hair trim.
Considering this was our first time here, I'm pretty surprised how well it all went. Maybe I've become an expert at getting my dogs' unique needs expressed to the groomers....or they just did everything I asked without my needing to remind them about this or that. I'm leaning towards the latter.
Pleasantly surprised by Pet Wash, and we'll definitely come back.

I’ve been bringing my cat here for a while and have always requested the same haircut and grooming service without any changes. However, during my most recent visit, I picked up my cat and found that his tail had been shaved off—something I specifically did not ask for.
I made it clear at drop-off that I wanted his usual grooming, and the front desk staff was aware of this. Despite that, the groomer still shaved his tail, which is very upsetting and completely unacceptable.
This was a really disappointing experience, and unfortunately, I will not be returning.
Great solution for self service dog bath!
I’ve been going to pet wash since 2009 and have recommended them to many who are very happy. The owner Victoria is great. Thank you

This was my first time here and I will be back! They asked a lot of questions about what I wanted for my cat upon drop off, which made me feel like he was in good hands. When I picked him up, he looked so cute and the cut was just how I wanted. Thank you!

I am so happy with my experience at Pet Wash. we take Jojo there regularly and that is the only place that my dog likes and would stay easy. The service is amazing and very friendly and professional staff. I highly recommend.
Always A great experience I brought my previous dog here all the way up until he passed and I also am now bringing my new baby Bradley and they always do a great job. I will continue to come here.

I’ve taken 2 dogs over an 8 year period to get their teeth cleaned at Pet Wash.  Am very happy with their service.  I DO recommend them highly.
And my dogs aren’t unhappy about going there for this experience.  So all good.
I chose this place because it’s close to my home and offers grooming services for cats. I was completely satisfied and will go back to Pet Wash!
They got my buddy Frank cleaned up nicely!! It is a challenge to clip Franks nails, they were patient and got it done! This will be my go to place from now on!
Owner is great - very knowledgeable and Lola seemed to want to stay with her after her spa day kinda annoyed about that part … anyways 10/10
Pet wash is the best.  They do a great job for all services: bath, cut, nails trimmed, etc.  the team is always kind and professional.
Amazing service! Very kind and gentle with my doggie!

Cute little pet grooming and supplies storefront.  Friendly staff, clean establishment - and my Pug was at his most handsome when after the session!  I will definitely take him there again.  So much better than PetSmart or PetCo!
i’m doubling down on my last review! my kids are two years older and many pounds more feisty and the team at Pet Wash accomplishes what i can’t - the dreaded nail clipping! Pet Wash is the best!
Excellent service I highly recommend this grooming service for both self wash or this groomers.
Paulo did an amazing job on my Shih Tzu, I also take my cats there for nail clippings. The staff is friendly , It’s always a pleasant experience
Great place to get my fur babies groomed at. Everyone is really nice and it’s close to where I live.
Very professional service
I love this Place! Reasonably priced for Cats and loved the Service Provided!
Friendly staff always willing to give my corgi the best grooming experience!

I had an amazing experience at Pet Wash in Hollywood. They did an extremely good job grooming my Shih Tzu. She was pretty heavily matted on her underside, and I really appreciated that they called me first to explain the situation and ask for my permission before shaving her down. That level of communication and care meant a lot to me.

The grooming took about two hours, and when I picked her up, she looked absolutely beautiful. They did such a great job—she literally looks like one of those fancy, rich dogs now. 😍

You can tell they truly care about the dogs and take pride in their work. I’m very happy with the results and will definitely be bringing her back. Highly recommend!
My cat was in and out for a nail trim within 10 minutes. The pricing is extremely reasonable. The staff is also extremely friendly.
Great friendly service
Very happy!

I hadn’t gotten my Chihuahua’s nails trimmed anywhere for a few years and had been doing it myself. The last place I used in another state would make me pay twice and come in two days in a row to get the full service done it was ridiculous. But the girl at the counter was friendly and the guy I didn’t really talk to but he brought my dog back out to me and he had done an excellent job. It was pretty quick too.
I love pet wash! For me it’s local, clean, the staff and groomers are amazing, the service is fast. I highly recommend pet wash!

After my cat had gotten wild not letting groomers trim her nails and causing me to change 4 groomers I finally found this place on the verge of despair and this place did a wonderful job. Fully recommended!
Everything just perfect

I took my dog here yesterday and she came back with two bloody wounds on her ears! Not one wound but two and both ears! I also think that they could’ve put something in her that made her lethargic and very tired. How is it accidental that you cut both of a dog’s ear off and you’re a dog groomer? Shouldn’t you have experience and not make such a terrible mistake now my dog is in pain! Do not come here!!

I took my crazy cat cappuccino in for nail cutting..it was quick and easy…
They were very pleasant

Despite a spatter in the morning and communication issues they performed a fantastic job on my three Shitzu’s. Thank you so much. I have been using this groomer for over 16 years if not more and we had 13 dogs at one point. Grateful 4 a reliable service.

The saving Grace of this place is the low price to wash your own animal. Put something that irritates me is when you put up a sign that says the last dog washes at 5:00 p.m. but you tell everybody it's 4:30 p.m. you close at 6:00! Some folks have to leave work early to try and get here at 4:30, so to be so rigid and lack customer service by turning customers away that are  just a little late is not something customer-facing businesses should practice in my opinion.
Fantastic store… You get to pick and choose services for your dog or wash them yourself… I highly recommend this place
Thank you so much you really do great job🤍 …
High quality grooming and excellent customer service
Reasonably priced very organized Dog is happy. I’m happy.
Our Benny came home looking adorable.
Great experience! Awesome place, great prices, and nice people.

I went there on a monthly basis for the self-service bathing of my dog. I always check availability before making a visit to stay away from any inconvenience. I have built a strong relationship with Pet Wash staff as they are highly friendly, supportive, and caring. A great service package all in all!!!

I have been a loyal customer bringing 3 different dogs for over the past 5 years.
Today after booking as usual over the phone I got a text telling me to click the link and pay a $25 deposit. Sorry but in this day and age with all the phony text scams, I am not going to click a link, provide a CC # and pay in advance for anything, especially to shampoo my dog. New policy I was told. Well call me an old customer then.
Hint to ownership: I was told when booking that the entire day was free so choose a time; not a good sign.
The staff is kind hearted and knowledgeable! 10/10 would recommend to everyone!!!
Thank you for taking Koko short notice for a nail trim, they look great and at $15 so affordable!!
Brought my pug here many times and each time he’s come out looking great. Great service!
took my lil yorkie in and she looks stunning also with my pitbull and the de shed is worth it . S/O THIS PLACE ‼️

Pet Wash in Los Angeles stands out as a truly dependable spot for pet care. I brought my dog in for a flea and tick treatment, and the experience was top-tier from start to finish. The staff handled my dog with calm confidence, clearly experienced with anxious pets. The facility is spotless, well-organized, and equipped with high-quality grooming tools. What impressed me most was the thoroughness of the treatment—every step was done with attention to detail. My dog came home noticeably more relaxed and completely pest-free. I'll definitely return for regular treatments and recommend it to other pet owners.

I was happy to get a same-day bath appointment and my dog is clean. Would've been a 5-star review but the paws were not trimmed despite me specifically requesting it. Or if they were then I can't tell the difference.

UPDATE: I will be suing this grooming company! My dogs furr has not grown back and she also caught some type of infection from the services that has her skin irritated and super inflamed! In the areas she was shaved to low on she has been biting at those areas and losing more furr!

I’m extremely disappointed!!!! I’ll never take my dog here again & I shouldn’t have paid them before seeing my dog first! I even tipped … smh I’ve never picked up my dog from any groomer like this after a shave…. It had to be super uncomfortable for her… we were so excited to take all that hair off being that it’s getting super hot … I’m so sad her old groomer closed her business … literally no excuse I do a better job doing it myself but her doggy clippers broke so I had to take her in …. Super happy there are no cuts but her ear flesh and toe knuckles … cut her whiskers off just an absolutely horrible job … grooming her usually cost around $60-65 is what I normally pay and they do an amazing job and I paid $85 for my dog to walk out like this!!! I want my money back!!!

so far they were gr8. I brought my 7 year old persian in and they did an absolute fabulous job. Next time I will be getting a lion cut and she has some swollen nipples. I hope everything goes well. BRAVA
Fantastic place to take your pet. Fast, friendly friendly and not too costly.
Good place for cats too.
My dog always comes out looking amazing and happy!

the person who washed my dog did a great job, but the other employee (maybe the owner?) was rude, dismissive, and completely unhelpful. no basic customer service, no solutions offered, just attitude and blame.

i called in advance for a wash and cut, confirmed everything clearly over the phone. showed up the next day and at check-in, with a line of customers behind me, the woman at the front desk kept insisting it was only for a wash. she argued, repeated herself over and over, and made me feel like it was somehow my fault — never once offering a fix, a reschedule, or even listening.

they had my dog for over an hour and a half. for a basic buzz cut, is that really not enough time? it’s not like i asked for anything complicated.

then at checkout, she tried to charge me full price like i hadn’t already paid a deposit the day before. when i mentioned the deposit, she gave me attitude and took several minutes just to look it up. the whole thing felt shady.

worst of all, she went to the back to get my dog and i had to wait over 5 minutes. i stood there trying to watch through a closed door, and honestly, that made me really uncomfortable. anyone who loves their dog knows that feeling — when your gut tells you something’s off.

i regret leaving my dog here. i didn’t feel at ease, and the way i was treated made it worse. if they’re busy enough to treat paying customers like this, good for them — but they won’t see me again.

i usually tip well. not this time.
Excellent!!! Always  professional and friendly!!!

I only take my dogs to Pet Wash.  The do the most amazing job with all 3 dogs.  The staff is so caring, I feel totally comfortable leaving my babies in their care.  Haircuts and de-shedding treatment are impeccable!
I had a very good experience at Pet Wash. They were very friendly and my dog looks great!
Very professional!!!
Excellent service, highly recommended!
Always a consistent experience! My pup and I are very happy with Hollywood Pet Wash!

This spot is fantastic for a do it yourself dog bath. The staff are helpful and friendly and provide efficient service. The room has two deep sinks and comes outfitted with towels, soap, conditioner, and a blow dryer. I’ve never had to wait more than a few minutes and it’s in and out quickly. Highly recommend this place.
Love the place, always polite and smiling.
Love this place, best pet wash in West Hollywood area and just tried out their grooming service and Baker looks amazing! Thanks so much
The best dog groomers, and great prices! Friendly staff, family owned and operated. SUPPORT SMALL BUSINESS!!! They can handle most of your pet needs
Excellent dog groomer. Staff is very friendly. Prices are reasonable. My pet was happy.

I was keeping a friend's dog that needed to have  nails clipped. When I took the dog to pet wash they took her in immediately. It only took about 15 minutes and on top of that I got a discount. I could not have asked for better service.
Always great
Great experience using their self wash stations. Friendly staff and clean space. Pricing is very reasonable and includes everything you need. Will return.
Quick, Easy, Hassle free, clean dog - In and out ! Great service
It was my first time and i love it.
My dog Birdy is always happy to go in and very happy when comes out. That means to me they treat her nice. Thank you pet wash
I really love this place.  Everyone who works there is super friendly and my dog always looks cute when he’s done.
Great job, will use again

My dog seemed to be unhappy apparently compared to earlier in the day after i picked him up at the store. He dont show any intimates lasting for almost a day but getting better now, so i assumed he must experienced something bad during the washing. Anyways, good trimmed for my pet hair but uncomfortable experience for the pet.
Did a self-wash. Quick and easy. Friendly service as well.
They are the best! They took care of 2 Wheaton Terriers and made them look beautiful!

Cat is very happy with the cut! He’s been purring a lot. It does look a little rough in the front legs area, so I’ve deducted a star, but honestly I don’t mind it and neither does he.  Hopefully the handler / groomer was gentle, but cat didn’t seem different afterwards. First time grooming and getting a lion’s cut. Cat is very happy and purring a lot. His hair will grow back. Price point is reasonable!
Worst grooming spot. Super rude, not gentle with pets at all, very messy work and I got three different prices from two people. Never going back there again

At Hollywood Pet Wash, they really care about the well being of the dogs. I have been taking my dog to get groomed there for 2 years and they never disappoint. Friendly service (especially the new girl who works on Sundays) and very efficient. I highly recommend the establishment!

Stellar Review for Pet Wash:

I cannot recommend the Pet Wash enough! They took such wonderful care of my beloved Joan during her recent grooming session. From the moment we walked in, their professionalism and genuine care for pets were evident.

Joan can be a bit shy, but the Pet Wash associates was incredibly patient and gentle, quickly putting her at ease. The grooming itself was top-notch—Joan’s coat has never looked or felt better, and the attention to detail was impeccable. They even took the time to ensure her nails were perfectly trimmed and filed, which is always a challenge with her.

What truly stood out was the extra love and care they provided. Joan came home happy, relaxed, and looking like a million bucks! It’s clear that Pet Wash genuinely loves what they do and treats every pet as if they were their own.

If you’re looking for a groomer who’s skilled, compassionate, and reliable, look no further than Pet Wash. Joan and I are already looking forward to our next visit!
